svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The application uses /dev/ublkbN. The block layer turns its reads and writes into requests with tags and gives them to ublk_drv. The ublk server in user space talks to ublk_drv with I/O commands on /dev/ublkcN and control commands on /dev/ublk-control, and keeps the data in local SSD files and S3.
